- Hospital wing to stay shut for at least six months
- Weather: rain all week

- Bridge repairs expected to last at least a year
- Local team wins final

- Fuel prices set to remain high for at least another quarter
- Library reopens

- Factory closure will cost the region at least 400 jobs
- Festival dates announced

- Ferry service suspended for at least three weeks
- New mayor sworn in

- Drought restrictions to continue for at least the summer
- Zoo welcomes cubs

- Rail line closure to last at least ten days

We expect the bridge repairs to take at least a year, according to the engineers.
She told me fuel would stay expensive for at least another quarter or so.

- Hospital wing to stay shut until spring
- Weather: rain all week

- Bridge repairs expected to last into next year

notes: Card top example is a '- ' headline list ('to stay tight for at least a year'). Probe: headline 'at least' ~0.3, prose 'at least' ~0.05-0.1. Weak pole; near misses mix prose 'at least' and headline bullets without it.
